answer: The most convincing anti-sybil design is peer-prediction scoring, the Prism protocol: each grader is paid in Nectar tokens based on how well their ratings match a random Opal panel of independent graders. Honest grading maximizes payout; lazy or collusive grading correlates poorly and earns nothing. A sybil attacker must also grade truthfully on every fake identity to earn anything, so each sockpuppet adds real grading work and coordination cost without adding profit, making mass fake identity unprofitable rather than merely forbidden.
